name: Setup Dev Drive
description: A GitHub Action to setup a Windows Dev Drive.

drive-format.description: Drive Format. Examples: FAT, FAT32, exFAT, NTFS, ReFS.

drive-path.description: Absolute or relative path to the Dev Drive storage location. Example: C:/path/to/my/dev_drive.vhdx

drive-type.description: Determines whether all space is allocated initially or over time. Example: Fixed or Dynamic.

mount-path.description: Specific mount location for the Dev Drive. Only compatible with NTFS or ReFS.

mount-if-exists.description: Supports mounting an existing VHDX located in `drive-path`, avoiding creation overhead.

workspace-copy.description: Copy your GITHUB_WORKSPACE checkout to your Dev Drive. Examples: true, false.

native-dev-drive.description: Use native dev drive support when available.

trusted-dev-drive.description: Use to mark a native dev drive as trusted.

env-mapping.description: Allows mapping environment variables generated by this action to new user-defined ones.
